👥 Basics

Collaborative filtering

In simple words

Recommending things that people with tastes like yours enjoyed, without knowing what the things are about.

A way to make recommendations from what many people did. The system finds people whose history (likes, views, purchases) looks like yours and suggests what they liked that you haven't seen yet. It doesn't need to know what a video or song is about, only who liked what.

Example. You and another viewer both loved three space videos. She also loved a video about volcanoes, so the app suggests it to you.

Related words

  • Recommendation systemAn AI system that suggests things you might like, based on what you and similar people chose before.
  • Filter bubbleWhen recommendation algorithms keep showing you more of what you already like or believe, so you rarely see anything else.
  • DataFacts and information a computer can store and use, such as numbers, words, pictures and clicks.
